repos_data.description: Push-to-talk voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On-device or cloud speech recognition, AI polish with presets, a dictionary, rules and scenes, long recordings with subtitles; the phone works on its own or pairs end-to-end encrypted as the computer's microphone and keyboard.
Hold Fn, speak, paste. Streaming Deepgram dictation for the macOS menu bar, with live paste and clipboard restore.
